gloss: busy farming season; peak agricultural period

definitions.gloss: busy farming season; peak agricultural period
definitions.explanation: The time of year when farming work is most intensive, particularly during planting (spring) and harvesting (autumn). The opposite of {農閑期|のうかんき} (slack farming season).

examples.japanese: {農繁期|のうはんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: There aren't enough workers during the busy farming season.

examples.japanese: {農繁期|のうはんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: During the busy farming season, we work in the rice paddies from morning to night.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農繁期|のうはんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧{子|こ}ども⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In the past, many children would miss school during the busy farming season.

notes:
Compound of {農|のう} (agriculture) + {繁|はん} (busy/flourishing) + {期|き} (period). In Japan, the main {農繁期|のうはんき} periods are spring (⟦{田植|たう}え→田植え：22734_taue⟧, rice planting) and autumn (⟦{稲刈|いねか}り→稲刈り：05933_inekari⟧, rice harvesting). Historically, school schedules and local events were arranged around these periods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農繁期|のうはんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the busy farming season
- {農繁期|のうはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧: helping during busy farming season
- {農繁期|のうはんき}⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧: farming season leave (historically given to school children)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{農閑期|のうかんき}→農閑期：25613_noukanki⟧: slack farming season — the opposite, the quiet period between planting and harvesting
- ⟦{繁忙期|はんぼうき}→繁忙期：08366_hanbouki⟧: busy season — a general term for any industry's peak period, not limited to farming
- ⟦{収穫期|しゅうかくき}→収穫期：21343_shuukakuki⟧: harvest season — specifically the autumn harvest period
